公司：Thyme Care
职位：Principal Product Manager Strategic Initiatives
地点：Remote
标签：product manager, exec, technical, customer support, testing, senior, ops, medical, engineer, recruiter

OUR MISSION
We exist to create a more connected, compassionate, and confident experience for people with cancer and those who care for them. We make it easier to get answers, access high-quality care quickly, and feel supported throughout treatment and beyond.
Today, Thyme Care is a market-leading value-based oncology care enabler, partnering with national and regional health plans, providers, and employers to deliver better outcomes and lower costs for thousands of people across the country. Our model combines high-touch human support with powerful technology and AI to bring together everyone involved in a person's cancer journey: caregivers, oncologists, health plans, and employers.
As a tech-native organization, we believe technology should strengthen the human connection at the center of care. Through data science, automation, and AI, we simplify complexity, improve collaboration, and help our care team focus on what matters most: supporting people through cancer.
Looking ahead, our vision is bold: to become a household name in cancer care, where every person diagnosed asks for Thyme Care by name. If you're inspired to make cancer care more human and to help reimagine what's possible, we'd love to meet you. Together, we can build a future where every person with cancer feels truly cared for, in every moment that matters.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
We're hiring a Principal Product Manager to set the product direction for new, zero-to-one initiatives focused on applying AI to make better care decisions in oncology â helping people receive the right, evidence-based treatment at the moment it matters. Working closely with senior clinical, operations, engineering, and business leaders, you will shape the strategy, identify the highest-value opportunities, and lead the most complex and consequential product work needed to build a solution with the potential to become a category-defining platform.
This is a hands-on, zero-to-one role for a product leader who can operate at both the strategic and implementation levels â moving fluidly between learning from users, defining product direction, partnering with engineering and other stakeholders to shape solutions , and driving execution to launch. You will establish the product foundation across workflow tooling, data integrations, and AI systems, while creating patterns that can scale across future products and initiatives. Much of this work sits at the intersection of applied AI, clinical guidelines, and operational workflows in a regulated setting where fidelity, auditability, and trust are non-negotiable. This is an individual contributor role today, with the opportunity to build and lead a product team over time as this business line grows.
Additionally, you will:
Drive the roadmap for a zero-to-one AI initiative to improve care decisions in oncology
Prototype, test, and ship AI powered products with engineering and other teams cross functionally
Build the workflow tooling and decision support surfaces clinicians and care teams need to act on AI recommendations
Own the evaluations, guardrails, and observability standards to ensure recommendations are accurate, safe, and trusted across, auditable, and defensible to clinical, provider, and health-plan stakeholders
Partner with engineering to shape the technical architecture around AI systems, data models, and integrations
Communicate tradeoffs and profess clearly to senior clinical, engineering, and business stakeholders
Leverage AI to accelerate your own work and help decide how the team uses AI tooling to move faster and prototype more efficiently
WHAT YOU'VE DONE
6+ years of product management experience, including leading zero-to-one or early-stage initiatives when the problem, requirements, and path forward were not fully defined
You have healthcare experience, ideally building workflow, data, or integration products for enterprise contexts
Youâre comfortable with ambiguity and defining a path forward for yourself and others
You have hands-on experience building or shipping AI/LLM-powered products
You communicate clearly and build alignment across engineering, clinical, and business stakeholders
You like to operate close to the technical details, such as data models, edge cases, evaluations, and impacts of implementation
Nice to haves:
Experience in oncology, serious illness / palliative care, or chronic condition management
Hands-on experience shipping AI/LLM-powered product features, including safety guardrails, evaluation, and quality measurement
OUR VALUES
At Thyme Care, our core values guide us in everything we do: Act with our members in mind, Move with purpose, and Seek diverse perspectives. They anchor our business decisions, including how we grow, the products we make, and the paths we chooseâor donât choose.
Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of the total compensation package that also includes equity, benefits, and other opportunities at Thyme Care. Individual pay decisions are based on several factors, including qualifications, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to other Thyme Care employees. The base salary for this role is $195,500-$230,000. The salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired at another level. This position is also bonus-eligible.
We recognize a history of inequality in healthcare. Weâre here to challenge the status quo and create a culture of inclusion through the care we give and the company we build. We embrace and celebrate a diversity of perspectives in reflection of our members and the members we serve. We are an equal-opportunity employer.
Be cautious of recruitment fraud , and always confirm that communications are coming from an official Thyme Care email.

公司：Bjak 
职位：Technical Product Manager AI Stockbroking App
地点：Germany
标签：product manager, exec, design, sys admin, infosec, technical, finance, ruby, mobile, ops, engineer, digital nomad

About KIRA
Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.
Â
In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
Â
Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.
We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.
If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
The Role
KIRA is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
Â
These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
Â
The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
Â
We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
Â
What You'll Own
Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.
Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.
Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.
Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.
Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.
Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.
Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.
Â
What We're Looking For
5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.
Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.
Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.
Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.
Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.
Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.
Â
Nice to have
Engineering or highly technical product background.
Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.
Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
Â
Outcome
Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap
Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch
Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds
AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted
Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged
Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction
Location
This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.
Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
Interview Process
Our process is designed to move fast:
Online assessment or practical task
Technical interview
CEO / final round
For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.role: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
jobs.text:
公司：Magic Eden
职位：Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
地点：Melbourne
标签：product manager, marketing, exec, design, crypto, nft, game dev, consulting, testing, analyst, finance, senior, golang, engineer, digital nomad

About Magic Eden and Dicey
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.
We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.
The role
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.
This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.
What you'll do
Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up
Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it
Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work
Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them
Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does
Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of
Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting
Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable
What we're looking for
Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required
Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist
AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further
High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first
Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others
Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it
Backgrounds that tend to fit
Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company
MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them
Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report
Why this is interesting
Competitive, top-of-market compensation
You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook
Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early
Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

职位：Principal Product Manager
地点：
标签：product manager, exec, infosec, marketing, design, web dev, scrum, cloud, api, stats, sales, engineer, digital nomad

DomainTools is looking for a Principal Product Manager to join its Product team. Data is the backbone of our products, and this role will be responsible for growing and refining the data products that drive our threat intelligence solutions, with API-first delivery and integration into UI, AI and third-party experiences and workflows. This is a strategic role for the company that has a high impact on the companyâs success, and has a great deal of visibility both inside and outside the company. The ideal candidate is a strong leader and successful product manager with a track record of delivering market-leading data products, with insights derived from direct customer interaction and big-data analysis. If you want to make a big impact in an established, growth-stage company, and if you love data product management, DomainTools is the place to be!
The product manager is expected to contribute to her/his team a solid knowledge of the various constraints of the business, and a prioritized assessment of the opportunities that the business can capitalize on. The product manager must also contribute to the product team a deep knowledge of our users and customers, and an understanding of the platforms that our customers use to engage with our products. Finally the product manager is expected to track industry trends and the competitive landscape as they pertain to their products.Â
While each member of the product team may be accountable for a specific area, we look for product managers that understand that consistent innovation is the result of each member of the product team contributing their passion and their ideas.Â The product manager must collaborate closely with engineering, marketing, sales and solutions engineering teams to deliver world-class solutions to market.
This job, as with the other roles on the product team, is an individual contributor role. You will need to be able to influence your teammates, colleagues, stakeholders, and key executives, through your use of data and logic.
Basic Qualifications:
Minimum 7 years in cybersecurity or data-related product management, delivering data-driven analytics and products
Deep knowledge of their business and its customers, understanding how data products are utilized by its users, and valued by buyers
Experience working with threat intelligence products, threat feeds, APIs, and related technologies
Experience interacting with customers who leverage data warehousing, data science, and Big Data technologies
Experience with integration of data products into third-party environments (both customer and partner ecosystems)
Experience working with Agile (kanban/scrum) development teams and processes
Excellent people skills, working with cross-functional teams across the organization to bring a solution from ideation to market
Excellent writing, communication, and presentation skills
US-based, with a willingness to accommodate core hours that overlap at least 9am-3pm US Pacific time
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience in cybersecurity investigations, threat defense, incident response, or related activities
Solid understanding of the cybersecurity market and modern security architectures
Familiarity with specific data domains used in cybersecurity, including DNS, IP, TLS/SSL certificates, web crawl, BGP, NetFlow data
Experience with real-time data collection, processing and delivery
Experience with large language models (LLMs) and agentic workflows
Experience with data products that leverage predictive analytics / machine learning (ML)
Experience with distributed systems and cloud computing
